title: Through the door, then the beach
decides: After the door shot (no cut), does a clip that starts from its last frame stay on the beach and keep Mara?
setting: A gentle short film in natural light, soft colour, steady camera, shallow depth of field.

subjects.words: Mara, a woman in her thirties with short curly red hair, round gold glasses and a mustard-yellow wool coat

beats.text: Mara walks through a walled spring garden under cherry blossom, petals in the air, toward a blue wooden door in the wall. She is seen from the side.
She stops at the blue door and puts her hand on the handle, her face in profile.
She pulls the door open. Through the doorway: a bright summer beach, white sand and blue sea.
She steps through the doorway onto the summer beach. The sea is in front of her and the blue door stands open behind her.
On the beach, Mara walks to the edge of the water, then turns to the camera and smiles.

checks: Garden, door, door opens, beach, edge of the water: in order, each once
Mara is the same person after the cut, when she turns
The second clip is on the summer beach (no garden)
No visible jump at the cut
